content:
incident-bot: ALERT: Pager — metering.alerts.token_drift (>15% across EU region). Service: billing-metering. Severity: P2. @oncall please triage

alex: I'm seeing overage flags spiking for 3 customers in EU acct bucket

katie: confirmed in dashboards — emit-rate for tokencounts dropped ~20% for writes into shadow pipeline

sre-jen: @alex can you paste the query you used? I want to check emitter latency

alex: running quick query:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM shadow_emits WHERE ts >= now() - interval '10 minutes' AND region='eu' GROUP BY minute;
```

alex: results show a gap between 17:03–17:12 UTC, counts near zero

billing-bot: INFO: detected discrepancy: billing-shadow vs canonical ledger = -18% in EU (17:00–17:15)

oncall: I'm on it, starting live triage. Collecting logs from emitter-2 and proxy-asia

ops_mike: noticed increased 429s from api-proxy -> emitter (rate-limiter tripping). Metrics: proxy.rate_429 spikes

katie: possible root: rate limiter misconfigured after yesterday's deploy (config change: emitter.rate_limit_per_key)

sre-jen: can we temporarily relax the limiter for shadow writes to burst=1000? That should allow replay

oncall: I'll patch limiter to allow shadow route=unthrottled for 20m and kick a replay job

alex: replay started: job id rpl-170882-01 — reprocessing 17:00–17:15 window

billing-bot: WARNING: customers receiving overage flags: cust_A, cust_B, cust_C. Flagging for manual hold until reconciliation

katie: note: hold will prevent billing emails; ops to confirm with billing-runbook

ops_mike: applying hold to flags for those three accounts now :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oncall: patch applied, replay is 12% complete, CPU on emitter-2 at 80%

sre-jen: also enabling short-term fallback: route tokencounts to backup-emitter in eu-west-2

alex: backup-emitter accepts writes; incoming gap filling

billing-bot: INFO: after replay progress=35% discrepancy reduced to -7%

katie: start tracking a rolling verification job to match shadow vs canonical every 5m

oncall: agreed. I'll keep thread open and handoff to night oncall @ops_night in 40m. Next steps: complete replay, run reconciliation, lift holds once delta <1%

ops_mike: logging followup ticket: MET-2026 — postmortem + revert check for yesterday's rate-limit change

alex: customer comms draft: "we detected temporary billing flags; no charges assessed until verification completes. We'll follow up in 24h." Please review

katie: LGTM. Add note about root cause being rate-limit config and mitigation steps

incident-bot: RESOLVE INITIATED: replay finished 17:48 UTC. Verification delta now -0.6%. Please close when comms sent and postmortem filed

oncall: closing here, handing to @ops_night for monitoring. Followup: MET-2026 assigned to @sre-jen

sre-jen: filed MET-2026 and assigned PR to rollback rate-limit change if tests fail

alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
